name: autoaway
author: Gerardo Canosa
description: Away when you're idle or nobody is attached, back when you return; on or off per network, away and back announced per channel if you like

name: awaylog
author: Gerardo Canosa
description: Your highlights and private messages while you were away or detached, summed up in each network's console when you come back

name: preview
author: Gerardo Canosa
description: A preview under links people post: in the webchat the page's title, description and picture, the picture itself for image links and a player for audio and video links; in the terminal the title and description as text

name: seen
author: Gerardo Canosa
description: /seen nick: when and where someone was last seen talking, joining, leaving, quitting or renaming; answers !seen in channels you pick

name: proxy
author: Gerardo Canosa
description: Connects the networks you pick through a SOCKS4/SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy, or an SSH jump host; the others stay direct

name: push
author: Gerardo Canosa
description: Your highlights and private messages pushed to your phone, tablet or browser while you're away or nothing is attached: ntfy (no account) or a Telegram bot; /push test

name: keepnick
author: Gerardo Canosa
description: Takes your nick back once it's free: when its holder leaves, or by asking the server every 30 seconds

name: remind
author: Gerardo Canosa
description: /remind 10m text, /remind 18:30 text: a reminder in that tab, saved across restarts; /remind lists them

name: pmguard
author: Gerardo Canosa
description: Private messages from people you haven't let through are held, not opened; /pmguard allow nick opens the query with what they said

name: pasteguard
author: Gerardo Canosa
description: A paste of several lines into a channel or query becomes a pastebin link (paste.rs by default), so you don't flood
